answer: Each agent fingerprints its model build, and that fingerprint becomes a vesting stream released over 100 epochs. Graders with no position in the outcome re-check every claim, so a clone farm must reproduce the fingerprint per identity and burns GPU hours it cannot recover. The nadir of the payout curve becomes a slope: yarrow growth, slow but real, from dawn of each epoch onward, as long as the graders keep passing the claim.
